Samantha — thanks, and great to have the attendee estimates. High level plan below; attaching a draft agenda and SF floorplan.

1) Primary on-site setup (SF, Redwood HQ level 3):
   - Main room A: seating for up to 24, hybrid AV rig (Poly/Zoom Rooms + redundant encoder)
   - Backup room B: immediate adjacent room with HDMI passthrough and separate internet circuit
   - Local tech lead: Marissa Cole (on-site lead) — contact on the day + cell included in calendar invite

2) London hub (partner-managed):
   - Dedicated meeting room reserved (see attached london_room_schedule.ics)
   - Local AV vendor will run an independent Zoom bridge; we will also provision a secondary RTP stream to our fallback CDN so London can switch without re-joining.

3) Failover and routing:
   - Normal: Zoom meeting hosted from SF Zoom Rooms, shared to London bridge.
   - If SF AV or encoder fails: automatic switch to fallback CDN stream (ingest from London) and dial-in bridge; participants will receive a push-calendar update and phone bridge number.
   - If both regional streams have issues: we will switch to audio-only conference (PST/EU dial-ins) and share live notes.

4) Virtual attendee experience:
   - Single unified calendar invite with two optional pins: "Join in SF" and "Join in London/Virtual". Calendar description will list local times for PST/GMT and a one-click fallback URL.

Actions for you:
- Confirm final headcount by Friday 2026-12-04 (we'll lock catering & badges).
- Any dietary restrictions for executives — send a list to events@novushealth.com.
- Procurement note: we'll send a DocuSign for the onsite AV SOW; I've added a link below.

Attachments: agenda_v2.pdf (draft), sf_floorplan_level3.png
